# Notesflix 101

> Interactive CBSE notes for Classes 9 to 12 from Notesflix 101 (founder: Vishal Kaushik; C&S Classes, Gurugram, India). Each chapter is split into short parts with simple explanations, flash cards, quizzes and board-style exam questions with model answers. Many parts are free to read (in Class 9, Part 1 of every chapter); the rest open with a subject password from Notesflix 101. Every subject also has a Practice Marathon of multiple-choice questions taken from the notes.

Key facts:
- Board: CBSE (India). Classes: 9, 10, 11, 12.
- Class 9 notes follow the new NCERT books for 2026-27 (Exploration, Understanding Society: India and Beyond, Kaveri, Ganga).
- Access: free parts open directly; locked parts need the subject password, available by email from support@notesflix101.com.
- Practice: weekly marathon (30 questions, 20 minutes, same set for everyone that week), 10-question sprint, 100-question mega marathon and chapter practice.

- [Class 10 Science notes](https://notesflix101.com/learn/x-science.html): 13 chapters, 23 parts, 1 free, 642 practice questions
- [Class 10 Social Science (SST) notes](https://notesflix101.com/learn/x-sst.html): 21 chapters, 36 parts, 0 free, 829 practice questions
- [Class 11 Business Studies notes](https://notesflix101.com/learn/xi-bst.html): 10 chapters, 43 parts, 0 free, 362 practice questions
- [Class 11 Economics notes](https://notesflix101.com/learn/xi-eco.html): 7 chapters, 20 parts, 0 free, 492 practice questions
- [Class 11 Physics notes](https://notesflix101.com/learn/xi-physics.html): 4 chapters, 11 parts, 0 free
- [Class 12 Accountancy notes](https://notesflix101.com/learn/xii-acc.html): 4 chapters, 14 parts, 1 free, 130 practice questions
- [Class 12 Business Studies notes](https://notesflix101.com/learn/xii-bst.html): 11 chapters, 39 parts, 2 free, 283 practice questions
